events.name: Bash
events.head: Check chaperone grep, patches, draft, publish hold
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git grep -ic chaperone -- app/src/components; echo "grep rc=$?"; ls workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/ | head -30; grep -n -i "T-072\|enterprise" workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md | head; ls workshop-plan/build/T-072-calcom-event-draft.md; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; ls app/scripts | grep -i funnel-boards

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run funnel probe, check mirror and Cal.com handle
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; timeout 180 node scripts/probe-funnel-boards.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/funnels/challenge/?v=t072v3" -o /tmp/ch.html; echo "TE=$(grep -o 'Tantra Enterprise' /tmp/ch.html | wc -l) CH=$(grep -io chaperone /tmp/ch.html | wc -l)"; for u in https://cal.com/adisuja https://cal.com/adisuja/tantra-enterprise-evaluation-call; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L $u)"; done; grep -n "publish held\|PUBLISH HELD\|publish resumed\|RELEASED" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md
